description: Scaffold and fully implement the React Native + Expo mobile app (prowash-mobile\). Depends on FEAT-001 being complete (backend endpoints must exist for the API service to call). The workspace root is c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PRO CAR.
steps: Step 1 — Scaffold: from 'c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PRO CAR' run: npx create-expo-app prowash-mobile --template blank. This creates prowash-mobile\ with bare Expo+React Native JS project.
Step 2 — Install Expo packages (from prowash-mobile\): npx expo install expo-camera expo-image-picker expo-media-library expo-av expo-file-system expo-permissions

Step 3 — Install npm packages (from prowash-mobile\): npm install @react-navigation/native @react-navigation/bottom-tabs @react-navigation/stack react-native-screens react-native-safe-area-context react-native-gesture-handler axios react-native-uuid @expo/vector-icons expo-constants

Step 4 — Create prowash-mobile\src\constants\colors.js with Colors object: midnightNavy:'#0B1B2B', oceanBlue:'#147DAB', aqua:'#40C4FF', cloudWhite:'#F4F7FA', softGray:'#E8EEF3', error:'#E53935', success:'#43A047', warning:'#FB8C00', text:'#1A2B3C', textLight:'#6B7F8E'.

Step 5 — Create prowash-mobile\src\services\api.js. Import axios. BASE_URL='http://10.0.2.2:5000'. Export: createInspection(vehicleModel,customerName)->POST /api/inspections, listInspections()->GET /api/inspections, getInspection(id)->GET /api/inspections/:id, uploadBeforeMedia(id,files)->POST multipart /api/inspections/:id/before-media (FormData with files as {uri,name,type}), startReturn(id)->POST /api/inspections/:id/return, uploadAfterMedia(id,files)->POST multipart /api/inspections/:id/after-media, compareMedia(id)->POST /api/inspections/:id/compare, getReport(id)->GET /api/inspections/:id/report. Set axios timeout to 120000ms. Add axios interceptor to log errors.

Step 6 — Create prowash-mobile\src\navigation\AppNavigator.js. Use NavigationContainer + createBottomTabNavigator. Three tabs: 'New Inspection' (icon: car-check from MaterialCommunityIcons), 'History' (clipboard-list), 'Reports' (file-chart). Tab bar background:#0B1B2B, activeTint:#40C4FF, inactiveTint:#6B7F8E. Each tab wraps a createNativeStackNavigator (or createStackNavigator). New Inspection stack: NewInspectionScreen (root) -> InspectionDetailScreen. History stack: InspectionHistoryScreen (root) -> InspectionDetailScreen. Reports stack: ReportsScreen (root) -> DamageReportScreen. Also add DamageReportScreen to New Inspection and History stacks so it is reachable from those flows.
Step 7 — Update prowash-mobile\App.js: wrap with GestureHandlerRootView (flex:1) and SafeAreaProvider, render AppNavigator inside. Remove boilerplate.
Step 8 — Update prowash-mobile\babel.config.js to add 'react-native-reanimated/plugin' to plugins array (required by react-native-gesture-handler/reanimated).

Step 9 — Implement prowash-mobile\src\screens\NewInspectionScreen.js: (a) Header 'PROWASH' in aqua on midnightNavy. (b) Vehicle model TextInput with live-filter FlatList suggestions (15 models list from plan). Tapping suggestion fills input. Manual entry allowed. (c) Optional customer name TextInput. (d) Handover timestamp display: device new Date() captured on mount, displayed as DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS in read-only styled box, updates every second via setInterval until saved. (e) Before media section: 'Take Photo' button (ImagePicker.launchCameraAsync), 'Record Video' button (launchCameraAsync with mediaTypes Videos), 'Gallery' button (launchImageLibraryAsync allowsMultipleSelection:true mediaTypes All). Thumbnails in horizontal ScrollView with remove button. (f) 'Save Handover Inspection' button: validate vehicleModel, call api.createInspection, if media then api.uploadBeforeMedia, navigate to InspectionDetailScreen with {inspectionId}. (g) Loading overlay during API calls. (h) Camera + media library permissions request on mount.

Step 10 — Implement prowash-mobile\src\screens\InspectionHistoryScreen.js: On mount+focus fetch api.listInspections(). FlatList of cards showing vehicleModel (bold), customerName, handoverTimestamp (DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM), returnStatus badge (orange 'Awaiting Return' / green 'Returned'), comparisonStatus badge (gray 'Not Compared' / teal 'Report Ready'). Tap -> InspectionDetailScreen. Pull-to-refresh. Loading spinner. Empty state with icon + message.

Step 11 — Implement prowash-mobile\src\screens\InspectionDetailScreen.js: Fetch getInspection(inspectionId) on mount. Handover section (read-only): vehicleModel, customerName, handoverTimestamp, horizontal scroll of before-media thumbnails (images show as Image, videos show play icon + filename, tap for full-screen). Return section: if awaiting_return show 'Start Return Inspection' button (calls api.startReturn then reloads). If returned: show returnTimestamp read-only box, after-media upload buttons (same Take/Video/Gallery pattern), thumbnails of afterMedia already uploaded, 'Compare Before & After' button (aqua, prominent — calls api.compareMedia with loading modal, then navigate to DamageReportScreen). If comparisonStatus===completed show 'View Report' button instead.

Step 12 — Implement prowash-mobile\src\screens\DamageReportScreen.js: Fetch api.getReport(inspectionId) on mount. Header 'Damage Report' + vehicleModel subtitle. Summary card. If noDamageDetected: green banner 'No obvious new damage detected.'. If warningMessage: amber banner. Damage items list with severity badges (red/orange/yellow), damageType, location, confidence percentage bar, description. Side-by-side before/after images (before from GET /api/uploads/before/:inspectionId/:filename, annotated after from GET /api/uploads/after/:inspectionId/annotated_:filename — construct full URL from BASE_URL). Comparison summary. Disclaimer text. Loading spinner on fetch.

Step 13 — Implement prowash-mobile\src\screens\ReportsScreen.js: Fetch listInspections, filter comparisonStatus===completed. Cards with model, customer, date, damage count, severity summary. Tap -> DamageReportScreen. Pull-to-refresh. Empty state.
Step 14 — Commit all mobile files: git add prowash-mobile\ (from workspace root git repo) and commit with message 'feat(mobile): complete PROWASH Expo React Native app'.
acceptance_criteria: npx expo export --platform android completes without red errors from prowash-mobile\
App launches on Android emulator showing the New Inspection tab with the PROWASH header
Vehicle model suggestions appear when typing in the search field
Camera permission request appears on first use of Take Photo
Creating an inspection navigates to InspectionDetailScreen and the record appears in History tab
Start Return button appears on InspectionDetailScreen when returnStatus=awaiting_return
Compare Before & After button triggers loading modal and then shows DamageReportScreen
Reports tab lists only completed-comparison inspections
verification: cd 'c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PRO CAR\prowash-mobile' && npx expo export --platform android --output-dir ..\..\..\tmp\prowash-export 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'ERROR|Cannot find|Module not found'  (should return no matches)
Start backend (npm run dev in prowash-backend\), then npx expo start --android in prowash-mobile\ — app opens without red screen on emulator
findings: All steps completed. Scaffolded Expo blank app, installed all required packages (expo-camera, expo-image-picker, expo-media-library, expo-av, expo-file-system, expo-permissions, react-navigation, axios, reanimated, etc.). Created src/constants/colors.js, src/services/api.js (BASE_URL=http://10.0.2.2:5000), src/navigation/AppNavigator.js with bottom tabs and nested stacks. Implemented all 5 screens: NewInspectionScreen, InspectionHistoryScreen, InspectionDetailScreen, DamageReportScreen, ReportsScreen. Updated App.js and created babel.config.js. Fixed missing babel-preset-expo during verification. Export completed successfully: 1464 modules, no ERRORs.
